title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.4.7
subtitle: Optional viewport controls for a faster simulation workflow.

highlights.title: New Look Viewport Bar
highlights.description: Enable New Look in Add-on Preferences for compact floating Simulation controls. The existing Simulation panel stays available when New Look is off.

highlights.title: Familiar Bake Workflow
highlights.description: Set the cache folder, choose a Quality preset, and Bake from the viewport bar. These controls use the same settings and operators as before.

highlights.title: Clear Status
highlights.description: A small status bubble shows whether the cache folder is valid, while Bake progress and important errors remain visible.
